learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic terms, principles and rules for estimation of measurement precision.
Understand the theoretical and practical aspects of the SI system.
Understand the principles, methods and means for measuring lengths and angles.
Understand the basic principles of normalization, tolerance design and the prescription of precision degrees for parts and units.
Develop practical skills for using some basic measurement devices.

syllabus_topics: Methods and means for measuring linear dimensions and angles
Precision of the geometrical quality indexes
Normalization and measurement of shape and positional deviations of surfaces and axes
Normalizing and measurement of: spline and key units, threads, conical parts and units, and gears

assessment_methods.method: Current test control (for each laboratory class)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is the average of the grades from the course assignment, practical and measurement skills, the first test, and the second test. If any of these four component grades is 'Failed' (2), the final continuous assessment grade is 'Failed' (2). The final grade also considers the results of the current test control.
